Field.Name: BeginString
Field.Description: FIXT.1.1

Field.Name: BodyLength
Field.Description: Number of characters after this field up to and including the delimiter immediately preceding the CheckSum.

Field.Name: MsgType
Field.Description: Message type.

Field.Name: SenderCompID
Field.Description: CompID of the party sending the message.

Field.Name: TargetCompID
Field.Description: CompID of the party the message is sent to.

Field.Name: OnBehalfOfCompID
Field.Description: Required for server-initiated application messages. This will be the CompID of the connection that originated the order referenced in the message being drop copied.

Field.Name: MsgSeqNum
Field.Description: Sequence number of the message.

Field.Name: PossDupFlag
Field.Description: Whether the message was previously transmitted under the same MsgSeqNum (34). Absence of this field is interpreted as Original Transmission (N).

Field.Name: PossResend
Field.Description: Whether the message was previously transmitted under a different MsgSeqNum (34). Absence of this field is interpreted as Original Transmission (N).

Field.Name: SendingTime
Field.Description: Time the message was transmitted. Not required for incoming messages sent by the clients (even if sent by a client, no validation will be done). Required for outgoing messages sent by the server.

Field.Name: OrigSendingTime
Field.Description: Time the message was originally transmitted. If the original time is not available, this should be the same value as SendingTime (52). Required if PossDupFlag (43) is Possible Duplicate (Y).

Field.Name: ApplVerID
Field.Description: Version of FIX used in the message. Required if the message is generated by the server.

Field.Name: DeliverToCompID
Field.Description: The value specified in the OnBehalfOfCompID (115) field. This will only be used in server-initiated messages. This field won't be received in RFQ-related messages.

Message.Name: Logon
Message.Description: Allows the client and server to establish a FIX session.

Field.Name: EncryptMethod
Field.Description: Method of encryption.

Field.Name: HeartBtInt
Field.Description: Indicates the heartbeat interval in seconds.

Field.Name: ResetSeqNumFlag
Field.Description: Indicates whether the client and server should reset sequence numbers. Absence of this field is interpreted as Do Not Reset Sequence Numbers (N).

Field.Name: Password
Field.Description: Password assigned to the CompID. Required if the message is generated by the client.

Field.Name: NewPassword
Field.Description: New password for the CompID.

Field.Name: SessionStatus
Field.Description: Status of the FIX session or the request to change the password. Required if the message is generated by the server.

Field.Name: DefaultApplVerID
Field.Description: Default version of FIX messages used in this session. This will be validated by the server.

Message.Name: Logout
Message.Description: Allows the client and server to terminate a FIX session.

Field.Name: SessionStatus
Field.Description: Status of the FIX session. Required if the message is generated by the server.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: The field will contain the next expected sequence number and the received sequence number if the server terminated the connection after receiving a sequence number that was less than what was expected. In other cases, the field will contain the reason for the logout.

Message.Name: Heartbeat
Message.Description: Allows the client and server to exercise the communication line during periods of inactivity and verify that the interfaces at each end are available.

Field.Name: TestReqID
Field.Description: Required if the heartbeat is a response to a Test Request. The value in this field should echo the TestReqID (112) received in the Test Request.

Message.Name: Test Request
Message.Description: Allows the client or server to request a response from the other party if inactivity is detected.

Field.Name: TestReqID
Field.Description: Identifier for the request.

Message.Name: Resend Request
Message.Description: Allows for the recovery of messages lost during a malfunction of the communications layers.

Field.Name: BeginSeqNo
Field.Description: Sequence number of first message in range.

Field.Name: EndSeqNo
Field.Description: Sequence number of last message in range.

Message.Name: Reject
Message.Description: Used to reject a message that does not comply with FIXT.

Field.Name: RefSeqNum
Field.Description: MsgSeqNum (34) of the rejected message.

Field.Name: RefMsgType
Field.Description: MsgType (35) of the rejected message.

Field.Name: RefTagID
Field.Description: If a message is rejected due to an issue with a particular field, its tag number will be indicated.

Field.Name: SessionRejectReason
Field.Description: Code specifying the reason for the reject. Please refer to the Reject Code Specification for the list of reject codes and meanings specific to London Stock Exchange.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Text specifying the reason for the rejection.

Message.Name: Sequence Reset
Message.Description: Allows the client or server to increase the expected incoming sequence number of the other party.

Field.Name: NewSeqNo
Field.Description: Sequence number of the next message to be transmitted.

Field.Name: GapFillFlag
Field.Description: Mode in which the message is being used. Absence of this field is interpreted as Sequence Reset (N).

Message.Name: Order Mass Status Request
Message.Description: Allows the client to request the status of all active orders for a particular Trader Group.

Field.Name: MassStatusReqID
Field.Description: Client specified identifier of the mass status request.

Field.Name: MassStatusReqType
Field.Description: Type of mass status request.

Message.Name: User Request
Message.Description: Allows the sponsoring user to submit a user activation, suspension or a user status query request.

Field.Name: UserRequestID
Field.Description: Client specified unique identifier of the user request. Maximum allowed length is 20. The server does not validate each UserRequestID for uniqueness. It is recommended that the clients ensure unique UserRequestIDs per user.

Field.Name: UserRequestType
Field.Description: Indicates the action required by the user request.

Field.Name: Username
Field.Description: User ID of the sponsored user. Maximum allowed length is 11.

Message.Name: Execution Report
Message.Description: Indicates an order or RFQ quote accepted, rejected, executed, expired or cancelled, an order cancel/replace, a trade cancellation, an order status, or an order mass status request rejection.

Field.Name: ExecID
Field.Description: Server specified identifier of the message. Will be "0" if ExecType (150) is Order Status (I).

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Conditionally required. Client specified identifier of the order. In the case of a quote, the QuoteMsgID (1166) or QuoteID (117) of the message last used to update the quote. When an Order Mass Status Request is rejected in its entirety, the ClOrdID (11) will not be present as the rejection is not related to a specific order.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: Will be filled with the actual original client order ID of the order, irrespective of the fact whether OrigClOrdID (41) was specified (valid or invalid value) or not, in the order cancel or cancel/replace request.

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: Conditionally required. Server-specified identifier of the order. In the case of a quote, the server-specified identifier of the executed side. This will be a 62 base encoded value in ASCII format. By converting this to binary, this can be mapped with GTP Order ID.

Field.Name: MassStatusReqID
Field.Description: Client-specified identifier of the mass status request. Required if the message is sent in response to such a request.

Field.Name: RFQID
Field.Description: Server-specified identifier of a RFQ.

Field.Name: QuoteRespType
Field.Description: Indicates the status of the RFQ quote. Note that this tag is not sent in the Trading Gateway Execution Report.

Field.Name: OrderOrigination
Field.Description: Whether the order, quote or RFQ was generated via Direct Electronic Access (DEA) or not. Only the following value will be sent.

Field.Name: LastRptRequested
Field.Description: Indicates the last message sent in response to a mass order status request. This will be set for the last message sent for each partition.

Field.Name: ExecType
Field.Description: Reason the execution report was generated.

Field.Name: ExecRefID
Field.Description: Reference to the execution being cancelled. Required if ExecType (150) is Trade Cancel (H).

Field.Name: ExecRestatementReason
Field.Description: Reason the order was restated. Required if ExecType (150) is Restated (D) and if order is cancelled via Market Operations.

Field.Name: OrdStatus
Field.Description: Current status of the order.

Field.Name: OrdRejReason
Field.Description: Code specifying the reason for the reject. Please refer to MIT801 for a list of reject codes. Required if ExecType (150) is Rejected (8) or for orders expired (C) due to Self-Execution Prevention validations.

Field.Name: TradingSessionID
Field.Description: Value submitted with the order.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Text specifying the reason for the rejection, cancellation or expiration.

Field.Name: LastQty
Field.Description: Quantity executed in this fill. Required if ExecType (150) is Trade (F).

Field.Name: LastPx
Field.Description: Price of this fill. Required if ExecType (150) is Trade (F). Will not be populated if Exec Type (150) is restated as (D).

Field.Name: LeavesQty
Field.Description: Conditionally required. Quantity available for further execution. Will be "0" if OrdStatus (39) is Filled (2), Cancelled (4), Rejected (8) or Expired (C).

Field.Name: CumQty
Field.Description: Conditionally required. Total cumulative quantity filled. Will always be "0" in the case of a quote.

Field.Name: SecurityID
Field.Description: Identifier of the instrument.

Field.Name: SecurityIDSource
Field.Description: Conditionally required. Identifier of the source of the SecurityID (48) value.

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: Client reference information.

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: Type of the order.

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: Time qualifier of the order. Absence of this field is interpreted as Day (0).

Field.Name: ExpireTime
Field.Description: Time the order expires, which must be a time during the current trading day. Required if TimeInForce (59) is GTD (6) and ExpireDate (432) is not specified.

Field.Name: ExpireDate
Field.Description: Date the order expires. Required if TimeInForce (59) is GTD (6) and ExpireTime (126) is not specified.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Conditionally required. Side of the order or quote that was executed.

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Conditionally required. Total order quantity. In the case of a quote, order quantity is always set to the bid or offer size submitted with the last quote update. It can even be the order quantity if it was an order which satisfies the formula Order Quantity = Leaves Quantity + Cumulative Executed Quantity.

Field.Name: DisplayQty
Field.Description: Quantity currently displayed in the order book. This field will also be populated for un-elected/parked orders.

Field.Name: DisplayMethod
Field.Description: Populated only if the value submitted with the order was 4 or the display size submitted with the initial order was zero.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Limit price. Required if OrderType (40) is Limit (2) or Stop Limit (4). In the case of a quote, the bid or offer price submitted with the last quote update. This field is not populated in the execution report sent for an RFQ. For Offset orders (OrdType (40) = F), if an order is parked (Order Status (39) = 9 Suspended), it will be populated with the Price (44) submitted by the user. Otherwise, it will be populated with the calculated price based on the DRP and the offset OR Price (44) submitted by the user (whichever is more conservative).

Field.Name: StopPx
Field.Description: Stop price. Required if OrderType (40) is Stop (3) or Stop Limit (4).

Field.Name: PreTradeAnonymity
Field.Description: Whether the order is anonymous or named. Absence of this field is interpreted as Anonymous (Y).

Field.Name: MDEntryID
Field.Description: Public Order ID

Field.Name: AccountType
Field.Description: Type of account associated with the order.

Field.Name: OrderCapacity
Field.Description: Capacity of the order.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Conditionally required. Time the transaction represented by the Execution Report occurred.

Field.Name: SecondaryClOrdID
Field.Description: A secondary ID assigned by the trading party.

Field.Name: ClOrdLinkID
Field.Description: Personal exposure of the trading party.

Field.Name: TradeLiquidityIndicator
Field.Description: Whether the order added or removed liquidity. Required only for messages generated for a trade or trade cancellations. Will be populated for both automatic trades (AT) and auction trades (UT).

Field.Name: TradeMatchID
Field.Description: The unique ID of the trade. This will be a 36 base encoded value in ASCII format. The base 10 format is available in tag 27020 DecimalTVTIC. Required only for messages generated for a trade (F) or trade cancellation (H).

Field.Name: TypeOfTrade
Field.Description: Indicates whether the executed portion of a passive order during continuous trading session is visible or hidden. The values are populated accordingly during Regular trading and CPX sessions, while for all other sessions enum 2 will be stamped. Valid only if ExecType (150) = F. Ignore value in all other cases.

Field.Name: PassiveOnlyOrder
Field.Description: Value submitted with the order or order amend request.

Field.Name: MinQty
Field.Description: Minimum Execution Size (MES) where specified on a pegged order. Following an execution, if the remaining quantity of order < MES specified in the order, Minimum Quantity = Remaining Quantity. For pegged orders with no MES and order types other than pegged, this tag will not be present. For orders with no MES submitted via the Native Trading Gateway, this tag will contain '0'.

Field.Name: LastLiquidityInd
Field.Description: Whether the order added or removed liquidity. Required only for messages generated for trades (Exec Type F) or trade cancellations (Exec Type H) during continuous trading and auctions. For other execution types, the value in this tag should be ignored.

Field.Name: ContraOrderBook
Field.Description: Identifier of the order book of the contra party of an RFQ execution. This field will only be populated in the Execution Report sent to the requestor when an RFQ executes with an order in the normal book. Absence of this field is interpreted as RFQ Trade book for RFQ related executions.

Field.Name: GroupID
Field.Description: Conditionally required. The Group ID of an Order. Will carry any value from 0 to 255. Zero is an ungrouped order.

Field.Name: AvgPx
Field.Description: Volume Weighted Average Price of all the executions reported so far for an RFQ on the requestor side and it will be the executed price on the quote side. This will be updated for trade cancels/corrections as well. AvgPx will be populated for all types of RFQs with an execution.

Field.Name: LastMkt
Field.Description: Market (Segment MIC) where execution took place. The value in this field should be disregarded if Exec Type is not Trade (F).

Field.Name: Offset
Field.Description: Offset for ATC TIF orders submitted with the order.

Field.Name: DecimalTVTIC
Field.Description: The base 10 format of TradeMatchID (TVTIC) (880) in the FIX Execution Report. This is the same value as provided by the GTP Trade ID and Native Trade Match ID (TVTIC). Required if ExecType (150) is Trade (F) or Trade Cancel (H).

Field.Name: TrdType
Field.Description: Type of Trade. Populated only if ExecType (150) = F or H.

Field.Name: PeggedExecInst
Field.Description: The instruction for permissioning to trade against mid-priced pegged orders. Any execution generated against a mid-priced pegged order will be on trading venue XLOX.

Field.Name: OwnerType
Field.Description: Optional identification (non-public) submitted with the order.

Message.Name: User Response
Message.Description: Used to respond to a User Request sent by the risk monitoring user.

Field.Name: UserRequestID
Field.Description: Client-specified identifier of the user request (MsgType=BE) the response corresponds to.

Field.Name: Username
Field.Description: User ID of the sponsored user in the corresponding user request.

Field.Name: UserStatus
Field.Description: Indicates the status of the user.

Field.Name: UserStatusText
Field.Description: Gives the reason for rejecting the user request.

Message.Name: News
Message.Description: Used to indicate the circuit breaker breach alert.

Field.Name: ApplID
Field.Description: Identifier of the partition.

Field.Name: OrigTime
Field.Description: Time the circuit breaker was breached (in UTC and in the YYYYMMDD-HH:MM:SS.uuuuuu format).

Field.Name: Urgency
Field.Description: Level of urgency of the alert. Always set as '1' (High Priority).

Field.Name: Headline
Field.Description: Headline or the subject of the alert. Always set as 'Circuit Breaker Breach'.

Message.Name: Business Message Reject
Message.Description: Used to reject an application message that cannot be processed.

Field.Name: BusinessRejectRefID
Field.Description: Client specified identifier of the rejected message if it is available.

Field.Name: RefSeqNum
Field.Description: MsgSeqNum (34) of the rejected message.

Field.Name: RefMsgType
Field.Description: MsgType (35) of the rejected message.

Field.Name: RefTagID
Field.Description: If a message is rejected due to an issue with a particular field, its tag number will be indicated.

Field.Name: BusinessRejectReason
Field.Description: Code specifying the reason for the reject. Please refer to MIT801 for a list of reject codes.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Text specifying the reason for the rejection.

Field.Name: PartyID
Field.Description: Identifier of the party. Short code in a range from 4 to 4294967295 can be used to identify the Client, Investment Decision Maker or Executing Trader. Value '0' is valid only for Client ID (PartyRole = 3) and Investment Decision Maker (PartyRole = 122) party roles. Values '1' and '2' are valid only for Client ID (PartyRole = 3). Value '3' is valid only for Executing Trader (PartyRole = 12).

Field.Name: PartyRole
Field.Description: Role of the specified PartyID (448). Counterparty Firm (17) will only be populated if Exec Type (150) is Trade (F) or Trade Cancel (H) for any order. Counterparty Firm (17) will be populated with a CCP if the trade is cleared.

Field.Name: PartyRoleQualifier
Field.Description: Provides a further qualification for the value specified in the PartyRole (452).

Field.Name: OrderAttributeType
Field.Description: Indicates if the order was generated via an algorithm or is submitted as a part of liquidity provision (i.e., as a part of the market making strategy).

Field.Name: OrderAttributeValue
Field.Description: Mandatory if OrderAttributeType (2594) is specified.

Field.Name: TrdRegPublicationType
Field.Description: Specifies the type of regulatory trade publication.

Field.Name: TrdRegPublicationReason
Field.Description: Populated when Execution Type is F or H. The Waiver Flags section describes in which scenarios the values are populated.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: TRADING HALT: An order to [buy/sell] [Order Quantity] @ [Price] breached the outer CB limit (Ref. price = [Price], CB lower limit = [Price], CB upper limit = [Price]) [Order ID]

Field.Name: SecurityID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of the instrument.

Field.Name: SecurityIDSource
Field.Description: Identifier of the source of the SecurityID (48) value.

Field.Name: RoutingType
Field.Description: Indicates the type of RoutingID (217) specified.

Field.Name: RoutingID
Field.Description: Identifies the recipient of the circuit breaker alert. RoutingID will be the Firm ID for RoutingType(216) = Firm(1). RoutingID will be the User ID for RoutingType(216) = User(10).

Only accept order if it will be at BBO or within two visible price-points. Otherwise expire order
